raw_html: [[Fire Shield (Cold) Miss-Guard|Fire Shield (Cold) Miss-Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Fire Shield (Cold) Miss-Guard]]:''' When you are missed, there is a 10% chance that a [[Fire Shield|Fire Shield (Cold)]] will be cast on you. If this effect activates while you have an active Fire Shield (Hot) from another source, they will nullify each other.
